request:
I curate Morpho's Sentora RLUSD Main vault. I want to raise a market's cap. build me the template and its report

Which market? kBTC/RLUSD 86% (market id 0x15bb2a6af0c909eed19fb1f2ceeead34ecbdcba626de752c6b09389ee14eec32), your recommendation. Only this one market.

title.en: Submit a Morpho Vault V2 market cap increase (curator)
title.zh-TW: 提交 Morpho Vault V2 市場上限的提高（curator）

summary.en: As curator, the Safe calls the vault's `multicall` with one `submit` inside, which queues raising the absolute cap of the market you pick to the amount you type. It only queues: once the vault's timelock has passed, anyone can execute it. It moves none of the Safe's assets.
summary.zh-TW: Safe 以 curator 身分呼叫 vault 的 `multicall`，裡面一個 `submit`，排隊把你選的市場的絕對上限提高到你填的數量。這筆交易只排隊：等 vault 的 timelock 過了，任何人都能執行。不動 Safe 的任何資產。

intro.en: Morpho Vault V2 spreads deposits across several Morpho Blue markets. The curator sets how much each market can hold (its cap), and the allocator moves funds within the caps. Raising a cap takes a `submit` first, and it can run only after the timelock has passed.
intro.zh-TW: Morpho Vault V2 把存款分配到多個 Morpho Blue 市場。curator 設定每個市場能放多少（上限），allocator 在上限內搬錢。提高上限要先 `submit`，等 timelock 過了才能執行。

text.en: Vault V2's GitHub lists 10 audits (Spearbit, Zellic, Blackthorn, ChainSecurity, Certora and one contest).
text.zh-TW: Vault V2 的 GitHub 列了 10 份稽核（Spearbit、Zellic、Blackthorn、ChainSecurity、Certora 和一場競賽）。

text.en: This template raises the absolute cap alone, in a `multicall` of one `submit`: the shape this vault's curator sent for every raise of a market already open, whose relative cap stands at 100%. Raising the relative cap too is another template.
text.zh-TW: 這個模板只提高絕對上限，`multicall` 裡一個 `submit`：這個 vault 的 curator 提高已開放市場的上限時都這樣送，那些市場的相對上限已是 100%。連相對上限一起提高是另一個模板。

recommendation.en: Use it for a market whose relative cap is already 100%. Any other shape gets MISMATCH: do not sign it, ask for that template.
recommendation.zh-TW: 用在相對上限已是 100% 的市場；其他寫法會判 MISMATCH，不要簽，改要那個模板。

text.en: AI has no browser that runs JavaScript, so it did not open the market's page on the Morpho app. AI read Morpho Blue's `idToMarketParams` on chain for market id 0x15bb2a6af0c909eed19fb1f2ceeead34ecbdcba626de752c6b09389ee14eec32, and the oracle it answers is 0xBCC3D9834b84B32Cf540DBE948DEd4B47bec5ddb. The market id is the hash of the five parameters, so a different oracle means a different market.
text.zh-TW: AI 沒有能跑 JavaScript 的瀏覽器，沒打開 Morpho app 的市場頁。AI 在鏈上讀 Morpho Blue 的 `idToMarketParams`（市場 id 0x15bb2a6af0c909eed19fb1f2ceeead34ecbdcba626de752c6b09389ee14eec32），回答的 oracle 就是 0xBCC3D9834b84B32Cf540DBE948DEd4B47bec5ddb；市場 id 是五個參數的 hash，換掉 oracle 就是另一個市場。

recommendation.en: Open the market's page on the Morpho app and compare the oracle address yourself.
recommendation.zh-TW: 自己在 Morpho app 打開市場頁比對 oracle 地址。

role.en: The vault's asset, also the token the markets lend; the absolute cap is counted in it
role.zh-TW: vault 的資產，也是市場借出的代幣；絕對上限用它計算

text.en: Ripple's RLUSD token addresses page lists it under "RLUSD token addresses" as "Proxy address".
text.zh-TW: Ripple 的 RLUSD 代幣地址頁在「RLUSD token addresses」下列為「Proxy address」。

text.en: CoinGecko's Ripple USD (RLUSD) coin lists this Ethereum contract.
text.zh-TW: CoinGecko 的 Ripple USD（RLUSD）列出這個 Ethereum 合約。

text.en: Etherscan: verified as StablecoinProxy, an EIP-1967 proxy, created in block 20492031 by 0x3BAf6263aD9C9D0854405B4Cfe4310c556a3e6ab; Ripple names no deployer.
text.zh-TW: Etherscan：驗證名稱 StablecoinProxy，EIP-1967 proxy，區塊 20492031 由 0x3BAf6263aD9C9D0854405B4Cfe4310c556a3e6ab 建立；Ripple 沒寫部署者。

role.en: The factory that creates Vault V2 market adapters. It answers `isMorphoMarketV1AdapterV2` = true: it created the adapter
role.zh-TW: 建立 Vault V2 市場轉接合約的工廠，它回答 `isMorphoMarketV1AdapterV2` = true，轉接合約是它建立的

role.en: The Morpho Vault V2 factory. It answers `isVaultV2` = true: it created the vault
role.zh-TW: Morpho Vault V2 工廠，它回答 `isVaultV2` = true，vault 是它建立的

role.en: Morpho Blue itself; the markets live inside it
role.zh-TW: Morpho Blue 本體，市場在它裡面

role.en: The market's collateral token, Kraken's wrapped BTC
role.zh-TW: 市場的抵押代幣，Kraken 的包裝 BTC

text.en: Kraken's support article "What is kBTC?" lists it as the kBTC Ethereum smart contract; the page was served in Traditional Chinese, so the registry label is the Chinese one.
text.zh-TW: Kraken 支援文章「What is kBTC?」列為 kBTC 以太坊智慧合約。

text.en: CoinGecko's Kraken Wrapped BTC (KBTC) lists this Ethereum contract.
text.zh-TW: CoinGecko 的 Kraken Wrapped BTC（KBTC）列出這個 Ethereum 合約。

text.en: Etherscan: KBTCProxy, an EIP-1967 proxy, created in block 20836204; its implementation changed in blocks 23620743 and 25984828, now KBTCV3.
text.zh-TW: Etherscan：KBTCProxy，EIP-1967 proxy，區塊 20836204 建立；實作在區塊 23620743 和 25984828 換過，現在是 KBTCV3。

role.en: The oracle the kBTC market uses to price kBTC in RLUSD
role.zh-TW: kBTC 市場用來以 RLUSD 給 kBTC 定價的 oracle

text.en: Morpho API `marketById` for market 0x15bb2a6af0c909eed19fb1f2ceeead34ecbdcba626de752c6b09389ee14eec32 answers this oracle.
text.zh-TW: Morpho API `marketById` 對市場 0x15bb2a6af0c909eed19fb1f2ceeead34ecbdcba626de752c6b09389ee14eec32 回答這個 oracle。

text.en: On chain, Morpho Blue's `idToMarketParams` for that id answers this oracle, kBTC, RLUSD, the adaptive curve IRM and LLTV 86%.
text.zh-TW: 鏈上 Morpho Blue 的 `idToMarketParams` 對這個 id 回答這個 oracle、kBTC、RLUSD、adaptive curve IRM、LLTV 86%。

text.en: Etherscan: verified as MorphoChainlinkOracleV2, code first in block 24902073.
text.zh-TW: Etherscan：驗證名稱 MorphoChainlinkOracleV2，區塊 24902073 起有程式碼。

1.multicall.data.en: The calls the vault runs, fixed at one item: the `submit` that queues the absolute cap increase. Another item, such as a relative cap or a second market, gets MISMATCH.
1.multicall.data.zh-TW: vault 執行的呼叫，固定一項：排隊提高絕對上限的 `submit`。多一項（例如相對上限或第二個市場）會判 MISMATCH。

1.multicall.data[0].en: Item 1: `submit` stores the call below and the time it becomes executable, now plus the timelock. Only the curator may call it.
1.multicall.data[0].zh-TW: 第一項：`submit` 記下底下的呼叫和可執行時間（現在加 timelock）。只有 curator 能呼叫。

1.multicall.data[0].submit.data.en: The queued call: raise the market's absolute cap. Nothing changes until someone executes it after the timelock.
1.multicall.data[0].submit.data.zh-TW: 排隊的呼叫：提高市場的絕對上限。timelock 過後有人執行前，什麼都不變。

1.multicall.data[0].submit.data.increase.en: The data that identifies the cap. The vault uses its keccak256 as the cap's id; here it means "this market in this adapter".
1.multicall.data[0].submit.data.increase.zh-TW: 上限的編號資料。vault 用它的 keccak256 當上限的 id，這裡是「這個轉接合約裡的這個市場」。

1.multicall.data[0].submit.data.increase.en: The kind of id, fixed to this/marketParams: a cap on one market, not on the whole adapter or on a collateral token.
1.multicall.data[0].submit.data.increase.zh-TW: id 的種類，固定是 this/marketParams：單一市場的上限，不是整個轉接合約或某個抵押代幣的。

1.multicall.data[0].submit.data.increase.en: The vault's market adapter, through which funds go into Morpho Blue markets.
1.multicall.data[0].submit.data.increase.zh-TW: vault 的市場轉接合約，錢經由它放進 Morpho Blue 市場。

1.multicall.data[0].submit.data.increase.en: The market's five parameters, which together are the market you pick.
1.multicall.data[0].submit.data.increase.zh-TW: 市場的五個參數，合起來就是你選的市場。

1.multicall.data[0].submit.data.increase.en: The token the market lends, equal to the vault's asset.
1.multicall.data[0].submit.data.increase.zh-TW: 市場借出的代幣，等於 vault 的資產。

1.multicall.data[0].submit.data.increase.en: The token borrowers post as collateral in this market.
1.multicall.data[0].submit.data.increase.zh-TW: 借款人在這個市場抵押的代幣。

1.multicall.data[0].submit.data.increase.en: The oracle that prices the collateral in the loan token; a different oracle is a different market.
1.multicall.data[0].submit.data.increase.zh-TW: 以借出代幣給抵押品定價的 oracle；換 oracle 就是另一個市場。

1.multicall.data[0].submit.data.increase.en: The loan-to-value at which a borrower is liquidated, such as 86%.
1.multicall.data[0].submit.data.increase.zh-TW: 借款人被清算的貸款價值比，例如 86%。

1.multicall.data[0].submit.data.increase.en: The most of the vault's asset this market may hold, in RLUSD with 18 decimals. Executing reverts unless it is above the current cap; to lower a cap use `decreaseAbsoluteCap`.
1.multicall.data[0].submit.data.increase.zh-TW: 這個市場最多能放多少 vault 資產，以 RLUSD（18 位小數）計。不高於現有上限時執行會 revert；要降低用 `decreaseAbsoluteCap`。
